senses.gloss: प्सरस् प्सरस्. See under rt. 1. प्सा below.

प्सरस्, अस्, n., Ved. a favourite dish or kind of
food, feast, enjoyment, (occurring in connection with
महि; cf. मधु-प्˚); food, sacrificial food; देव-
प्सरस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. being a pleasure for the
gods, delightful to the gods.

प्सा 1. प्सा, cl. 2. P. प्साति (3rd pl. Impf.
अप्सुस् or अप्सान्), पप्सौ, प्सास्यति, अप्-
सासीत्, प्सायात् or प्सेयात्, प्सातुम्, Ved. to chew,
masticate, eat, consume; to go; [cf. Old Germ.
spīsa, ‘food;’ Mod. Germ. speise.]
प्सात, अस्, आ, अम्, chewed, eaten; hungry.
